issuer.summary: USDS is issued by Sky, formerly MakerDAO — among the longest-running and most audited issuers in the sector, DAO-governed, with a 48-hour governance security module on parameter changes, broad audit coverage and a $10M bug bounty. What holds it below the top of the range is that the contracts are upgradeable and a freeze can be added by governance, which is a censorship surface rather than a solvency one. Endgame structural complexity and a governance-capture tail are the other two reasons. See the full report for the governance path and allocator exposure.
issuer.summary_source: Internal assessment of the issuing entity, its governance timelock and audit posture. [verified 2026-08-21]
